### Summary

I am unable access my Streamlit Cloud account or access my applications on it. When I go to https://streamlit.io/cloud and click "Join Community Cloud" or when I go directly to the URL of my apps, I get a blank page that says "source IP address not allowed" on my laptop. 

However, when I do the same from my phone, I have no issues.

Here is a similar closed issue: https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/9208

![Views](https://api.views-badge.org/badge/st-issue-16523)
This issue was resolved by turning my VPN off and back on.

This report is about Streamlit Community Cloud access failing with a blank page showing **"source IP address not allowed"**, not a bug in the open-source Streamlit library. The message does not appear anywhere in this repo; it is almost certainly returned by Cloud edge/WAF/IP filtering. That matches the reporter’s symptoms (laptop blocked, phone OK) and their follow-up that **cycling the VPN fixed it**. This should be handled as a Community Cloud / network-access issue (support or status), not an OSS code change.

### Related Issues

- [#9208 – Problems accessing my account and application](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/9208): Same exact error text (`source IP address not allowed`); previously attributed to a temporary Community Cloud outage.
